title: 第12章 追击蝎虎斗罗——张鹏，千仞雪另有目的
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“史莱克学院，果然跟唐三唐门一样，伪善的让人恶心。不过，他史莱克学院这么做，倒是给我送了一个人才。不如......”

千仞雪紫眸闪烁着，心中已经有了对这个张鹏另外的安排。

于是原本准备敷衍应付的她，一离开史莱克学院便动作不小。

因此很快便追击到了张鹏。

然而张鹏原本听到史莱克学院的人追他，他是下意识想要逃走的。

毕竟他曾经与穆恩有过约定，避世不出的。

如今仅仅只是刚出来行走便被史莱克学院安排人追击他，他以为这是穆恩的意思，甚至有可能是穆恩的弟子，可是等到他发现是谁在追击他时，他傻了。

追他的居然是个小女娃？

史莱克学院这么看不起他吗？

就算穆恩不能亲自过来，玄子或者言少哲呢？

现在派一个93级的小女娃来是多么看不起他张鹏？

不得不说，这一刻张鹏真的怒了。

那被史莱克污蔑是邪魂师的委屈，被穆恩逼着隐退终日只能跟满山魂兽作伴的憋屈和不甘，通通在这一刻化为滔天的愤怒。

“史莱克，你们欺人太甚！老夫也不是什么阿猫阿狗都能欺负的！”

话毕，张鹏停下逃跑的步伐，转而转身，恶狠狠地盯着身后追击他的千仞雪。

“小女娃，识相的话赶紧滚回史莱克学院，否则今天我一定一报当年之仇！”

“哦？若我说不呢？”

“那就休怪我了！”

“吼——”

一声虎啸响起，下一秒以张鹏为中心，黑暗降临。

从他身后的黑暗中突然显现出一个巨大的黑虎，而这就是张鹏的邪武魂，暗魔邪神虎的亚种——蝎虎。

也是凭借这个，他被史莱克学院的穆恩定义为邪魂师。

但其实呢？

千仞雪的武魂却是没从他的身上感受到血腥，也就意味着，他确实算不上是一个堕落者，也就是邪魂师。

顶多算武魂邪恶，可万年前她就见过不少这样的。

不在天使神定义的罪恶内。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Shrek Academy is indeed just like Tang San's Tang Clan. It's hypocritical and disgusting. However, by doing this, Shrek Academy gave me a talent. How about..."

Qian Renxue's purple eyes flickered, and she already had other arrangements for Zhang Peng in her heart.

So she, who was originally prepared to deal with it perfunctorily, made a big move as soon as she left Shrek Academy.

Therefore, Zhang Peng was quickly pursued.

However, Zhang Peng originally heard that people from Shrek Academy were chasing him, and he subconsciously wanted to escape.

After all, he had made an agreement with Munn and could not escape from the world.

Now he was being chased by people from Shrek Academy just after he came out for a walk. He thought this was Munn's intention, and he might even be Munn's disciple. But when he found out who was chasing him, he was dumbfounded.

The person chasing him is actually a little girl?

Does Shrek Academy look down on him so much?

Even if Mu En couldn't come in person, what about Xuanzi or Yan Shaozhe?

How much do you look down on Zhang Peng by sending a little girl with level 93 here?

I have to say that Zhang Peng was really angry at this moment.

The grievance of being slandered by Shrek as an evil soul master, the frustration and unwillingness of being forced to retire by Munn and having to spend all day with the companions of the mountain of soul beasts, all turned into overwhelming anger at this moment.

"Shrek, you guys are going too far! I can't be bullied by just any cat or dog!"

After finishing speaking, Zhang Peng stopped escaping, turned around, and stared fiercely at Qian Renxue who was chasing him behind him.

"Little girl, if you know what's going on, go back to Shrek Academy immediately, otherwise I will avenge you today!"

"Oh? What if I say no?"

"Then don't blame me!"

"Roar——"

A tiger roar sounded, and the next second, darkness fell with Zhang Peng as the center.

A huge black tiger suddenly appeared from the darkness behind him, and this was Zhang Peng's evil spirit, a subspecies of the dark evil tiger - the scorpion tiger.

It was also because of this that he was defined as an evil soul master by Moon of Shrek Academy.

But actually?

Qian Renxue's martial soul did not feel the blood from his body, which meant that he was indeed not a fallen person, that is, an evil soul master.

At best, the martial spirit was considered evil, but she had seen many of them thousands of years ago.

Not within the sin defined by the angel God.
